prompt:
How many fire and EMS stations in Miami-Dade County, Florida are inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area?

Your working directory: /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/workspace/claude-haiku-5.5/Q5_2

datasets_used: HIFLD Fire and Emergency Medical Service (EMS) Stations (hifld/fire-and-emergency-medical-service-ems-stations, GeoPackage downloaded to workspace as fire_ems.gpkg)
output.method: I downloaded the HIFLD fire/EMS station GeoPackage and filtered the NFHL flood hazard polygons to SFHA_TF = 'T' (Special Flood Hazard Area) from the Miami-Dade 12086C extract. I then used Extract by location (intersects) to keep the stations falling within those SFHA polygons, which returned 40 stations; the stations are all in Miami-Dade because the NFHL extract only covers that county. The count does not include stations in Zone X or other non-SFHA flood zones.
